say: He says, "Vandals desecrated my tomb and left me like this. Could you please help me by replacing my lost garment and possessions."
The MUMMY takes from you: the JUG of embalming fluid, the funeral FOOD, the snake-shaped CHARM and the BANDAGES.
He thanks you profusely and runs off. You now notice the CLOTH of gold which falls off the slab as he disappears.
She says, "Vandals desecrated my tomb and left me like this. Could you please help me by replacing my adornments."
The MUMMY takes from you: the BRACELET of red gold, the ornate NECKLACE, the exotic PERFUME and the adorning KOHL.
She thanks you profusely and before she runs off she tells you a rather funny JOKE!
As your eyes become accustomed to the fire light, you see a Soothsayer sitting at the far end of the room. He is swaying gently from side to side as he chants strange words and music.
THOTH takes the GIFT and smiles!
You find yourself on the floor in your own home!
You turn off the computer and go to bed

"Welcome to my tomb", says THOTH, "I suppose you'd like to go home! Well if you bring me a gift worthy of a GOD, I may let you escape. To show you that I am not completely heartless, here is a pair of golden SCISSORS which you may find useful. NOW GO! This audience is at an end."
"Now, where's my gift" shouts THOTH. "I'm getting rather impatient! Do not return again without my gift or you may regret it!"
"YOU AGAIN! And no gift!" thunders THOTH. "Well that's your last chance. There's no escape now. I banish you to wander these corridors for ever and a day and longer!"
